name: zsnd_fade_lists_shutdown_at_exit
description: zSndFadeLists::ShutdownAtExit drains fade-list nodes, deletes both sentinels, and clears the global sentinel/count fields used by the atexit path.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification for zsnd_fade_lists_init_shutdown now fails ShutdownAtExit with 145 unmasked mismatches after 52 relocation bytes and 12 trimmed VC5 NOPs, BN size 204 bytes and VC object symbol size 160 bytes.

tier S remains open because the current source now advances dead nodes before deletion, matching the observed destructive traversal more closely, but loop/test codegen and unlink scheduling still differ from the original atexit cleanup.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a39b0 drains dispatch nodes through zSndFadeList::DeleteNodeAndAdvanceCursor, deletes the dispatch sentinel, drains active nodes by unlinking and deleting them, then deletes the active sentinel and clears both count globals.
The native init/shutdown smoke verifies explicit ShutdownAtExit deletes active and dispatch sentinel state after both lists contain nodes.
The child-process atexit smoke verifies Init registers the atexit callback and the process exits cleanly with live fade-list nodes.
